rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new modules hide substantial behaviour behind one entry point each: `data/selene_deck.py` behind `write_phase_description` (deck grammar, per-phase conversion, receipts), `data/eddb_remote.py` behind the extractor (one ssh process, request dispatch, refusal contract), and `data/eddb.py` behind `fetch_channels` (cache layout, token/overwrite invariants). None spreads its complexity as a family of small wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — every mechanism the plan touches names its owner and extends it rather than forking: roots through `data/paths.py`, pins through `gs/artifact_resolution.py`, the store through `data/eddb.py`, sign scoring through `data/cocos_convention.py`, transport through `data/eddb_remote.py`, and the shot set through `spine_bench/shots.py`. §5 explicitly leaves unit conversion with its existing owners (`signal_map.unit_factor`, `tokamap_export._unit_factor`) and adds only an author-time spelling file.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface states in its own text what it retires or why nothing can. §4 retires the `machine == "mast"` branch in `read_geometry_table`; §6 retires `mast_angle_to_canonical` and adds no ambix definition for the angle (the one class goes to nova); §5 adds one packaged data file and no public definition or refusal family; §7's two EQDB types retire nothing because no equilibrium-database request existed.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass (one census gap recorded as a finding) — the plan searched imas-codex and imas-ambix and cites the mechanisms it extends, each verified present in the tree: `data/description_reader.py` `read_geometry_table`/`read_acquisition_channels`, `data/transform_engine.py` `NetCDFTransformEngine.open`, the `StoreEngine` protocol, `data/cocos_convention.py` `score_convention`/`read_level2_observation`, `eval/efit_referee.py` `read_efit_geometry`/`judge_geometry`, `gs/machine_identity.py` `default_registry`, `gs/artifact_resolution.py`, and `spine_bench/shots.py` `BenchShot`/`resolve_shotset_version`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no proposed layer merely forwards to existing machinery without a stated reason. The EQDB request/record types (§7) and the `struct_array_entry` binding slot (§4) each carry a shape the existing contract cannot express (a 2-D psi record is not a channel; rank and position cannot select a struct-array entry), and the plan says so at each site.
